proposals.rationale: Findings 1, 5 and 8 show Route 3 is the worst offender: 232 riders left behind at Old Main (queue peaked at 229), 59 left at Stadium Station, and Route 3 ran 96% empty while University Station queued 53 during class_change. The champion only spaces buses at the terminal (even-headway, 234 fires) and never holds at stops, so a full bus leaves Stadium Gate just before the surge and the next one is minutes away. Holding a Route 3 bus at Stadium Gate for up to 60 s when event_in_s is small and the local queue is large lets it absorb the first wave of fans, cutting left-behinds and downstream queue growth at Old Main without materially delaying riders already aboard (the hold is bounded by maxHoldS=60 and the 180 s per-loop budget). A modest, bounded station hold (using the existing train_eta_s and expected_transfers features) lets r1/r2 absorb train alighting passengers without long dwell, and a short r3 Old Main hold prevents the 232-left-behind backlog. Because holds are capped by a new 75 s max and fire only on narrow conditions, bunching and downstream delay stay limited. Changes: Add rule train-feed-central: hold r2 bus at Central up to 60 s when a train is within 45 s and expected_transfers >= 8; Add rule oldmain-relief-r3: hold r3 at Old Main up to 55 s when queue_here >= 25 and headway_behind_s >= 240; Raise params.maxHoldS from 60 to 75 to give the bounded holds room while keeping all other params at 2/2/2 and 45 s train dwell.
